mapper.select: SELECT lDongRegnCd, regn_name AS regnName FROM ldong_regn_code ORDER BY lDongRegnCd
SELECT lDongRegnCd, regn_name AS regnName FROM ldong_regn_code WHERE lDongRegnCd = #{lDongRegnCd}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO ldong_regn_code target USING ( SELECT #{lDongRegnCd} AS lDongRegnCd, #{regnName} AS regn_name FROM DUAL ) source ON (target.lDongRegnCd = source.lDongRegnCd) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.regn_name = source.regn_name WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (lDongRegnCd, regn_name) VALUES (source.lDongRegnCd, source.regn_name)
mapper.select: SELECT lDongRegnCd, lDongSignguCd, signgu_name AS signguName FROM ldong_signgu_code WHERE lDongRegnCd = #{lDongRegnCd} ORDER BY lDongSignguCd
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO ldong_signgu_code target USING ( SELECT #{lDongRegnCd} AS lDongRegnCd, #{lDongSignguCd} AS lDongSignguCd, #{signguName} AS signgu_name FROM DUAL ) source ON (target.lDongRegnCd = source.lDongRegnCd AND target.lDongSignguCd = source.lDongSignguCd) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.signgu_name = source.signgu_name WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (lDongRegnCd, lDongSignguCd, signgu_name) VALUES (source.lDongRegnCd, source.lDongSignguCd, source.signgu_name)
